<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.50.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* refactor: deprecate kwargs in st.plotly_chart and add config dict instead by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12291
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.checkbox` & `st.toggle` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12372
* Remove `**kwargs` support from `st.write` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12375
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.number_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12437
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.text_area` & `st.text_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12397
### New Features 🎉
* Add `MultiselectColumn` for `st.dataframe` and `st.data_editor` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9223
* Add support for source directly in theming font configs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12239
* [feat] Add `default` param to `st.tabs` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12313
* Add `border` parameter to `st.table` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11796
* [feat] Hover, active, focus-visible states for CopyButton by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12348
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameters to `st.line_chart`. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11923
* Add main theme color config options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12288
* Use `key` as main identity for button widgets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12332
* Add `sort` parameter to `st.bar_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12339
* Add theme background color config options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12405
* Add theme text color config options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12438
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.time_input` & `st.date_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12464
* [feat] Add sample rate parameter to `st.audio_input` component by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12272
* Metric supports numerics like decimal. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12377
* Show slider tick labels on hover by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12367
* [AdvancedLayouts] Add height param to `st.graphviz_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12297
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.selectbox` & `st.multiselect` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12493
* Support configuring the chart column colors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12292
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Fix code usage in markdown labels by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12175
* [fix] Fullscreen behaviour for `st.image` with use_container_width=True or width="stretch" by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12235
* [fix] DateInput: normalize selected dates to start-of-day to honor max by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12295
* Ensure markdown images keep the aspect ratio by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12343
* Fix issue with typing formatted values into `st.number_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12351
* [fix] `html` with float height.  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12354
* [fix] Share more code between Selectbox and Multiselect to align behavior by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12330
* Fix logo pushing out collapse button by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12329
* Fix long-words overflowing markdown container by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12370
* Add MIME type for `.mjs` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12399
* Fix Pandas styler performance regression by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12422
* [fix] Allow empty section pages in top navigation similar to how we do it for sidebar nav  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12247
* [fix] horizontal alignment of st.image in vertical containers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12495
* [fix] Setting 0 for height/width on components.html and components.iframe .  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12479
* Fix duckdb integration test by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12537
* Revert number input component refactoring by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12547
### Other Changes
* Add default main colors to theme by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12334
* Release/1.49.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12328
* Release/1.49.1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12376
* Add default background colors to theme by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12341
* Make git utilities more robust by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12393
* Update cache headers to include `max-age` and `immutable` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12420
* Add default text colors to theme by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12407
* [chore] Adding latest material icons by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12473
* [chore] Updating material icons by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12535
